decision: Approve the four AttachmentField file-intake conventions (accepted-file-types, max-file-bytes, max-file-count, files-rejected) as proposed in the approved spec v0.1, without changing any existing component contract.

userStatements.provenance: Spec v0.1 owner decisions (2026-11-19): approval of the spec and of conventions C1-C4 in docs/components/attachment-field/v0.1/spec.md section 3 "Conventions to approve"

userStatements.quote: Apruebo, con el registro de aprobación (OQ1)
userStatements.provenance: Implementation plan approval (2026-11-19): OQ1 approves recording these four conventions with this approval record

limits: Binds only the four convention payloads below; reused conventions (label, value, defaultValue, onValueChange, messages) keep their existing approvals.
Dropzone accept, files-received and every existing component API are unchanged; no migration is implied.

convention.name: acceptedTypes
convention.meaning: Explicit list of MIME types a file field accepts; files outside it are rejected by the component itself.
convention.whenToUse: A component validates picked, dropped or pasted files by MIME type and reports rejections.
convention.avoid: A native picker filter that never rejects (Dropzone accept), file extensions, size or count limits.

convention.name: maxFileBytes
convention.meaning: Largest allowed size, in bytes, of one file accepted by a file field; a file of exactly this size is accepted.
convention.whenToUse: A component validates the size of each picked, dropped or pasted file and reports rejections.
convention.avoid: Total size across files, display thresholds, text length limits or scroll viewport heights.

convention.name: maxFiles
convention.meaning: Largest number of files a file field holds at once, counting those already attached; further files are rejected.
convention.whenToUse: A component limits how many files can be attached and reports rejections of the excess.
convention.avoid: Display overflow caps on counters, text length limits or per-file size limits.

convention.name: onFilesRejected
convention.meaning: Notification carrying the files a file field refused to attach, each with the rule it broke.
convention.whenToUse: A component validates files itself and lets the consumer log, mirror or react to rejections.
convention.avoid: Files that were accepted (use onValueChange), upload failures or the visible error text.
